requirements.action: request extra credit hours for an advising student and specify the courses and requested hours
requirements.rules: Probation students cannot receive extra hours. Other students may not exceed 34 total hours. A student not graduating within one year may add at most three hours above the standard allowance. A student graduating within one year may add hours up to the 34-hour maximum. Repeated-course hours cost EGP 1,000 each; new-course hours cost EGP 800 each.
requirements.implementation: New assigned-student form uses authenticated advisor identity and active catalogue. Select courses, graduation flag and submit actual course IDs; per-request checks and server-returned authoritative pricing.
requirements.coverage: partial: adapter present; documented server gap remains

requirements.action: view all extra-hours requests and their details
requirements.rules: Each request shows the student, requesting Advisor, requested courses and hours, eligibility checks, itemized cost, Coordinator decision, settlement status and submission date.
requirements.implementation: Coordinator queue and fresh individual-request GET, student/advisor/term/eligibility/cost/decision/settlement/history.
requirements.coverage: API-backed adapter present; live backend not re-certified

requirements.action: search extra-hours requests using a student ID
requirements.implementation: Coordinator student-ID search forwarded to the list endpoint.
requirements.coverage: API-backed adapter present; live backend not re-certified

requirements.implementation: Advisor, decision, settlement option and settlement status filters forwarded together.
requirements.coverage: API-backed adapter present; live backend not re-certified

requirements.action: approve or reject an extra-hours request and provide a response note
requirements.rules: Approval confirms the eligibility rules and itemized cost, then makes the request available for the student to settle. Approval alone does not activate the extra hours or add the courses to the usable schedule.
requirements.implementation: Noted approve/reject action. Whitespace-only notes and current probation approval blocked in UI. Approval is explicitly not activation.
requirements.coverage: partial: adapter present; documented server gap remains

requirements.implementation: Approved request displays each course, hours, rate, repeated-course flag, subtotal and total.

requirements.rules: The history shows refund credits and payment debits with the amount, date, related request or payment, and resulting balance.
requirements.implementation: Own wallet endpoint renders balance and credit/debit ledger with linked request/reference, time, status and resulting balance.
requirements.coverage: API-backed adapter present; live backend not re-certified

requirements.action: choose to pay an approved extra-hours request now or add its amount to my next university installment
requirements.rules: The request remains Awaiting Payment Choice until one option is confirmed.
requirements.implementation: Settlement choices are separate from confirmation; only approved awaiting-choice/failed/cancelled requests may proceed.
requirements.coverage: API-backed adapter present; live backend not re-certified

requirements.action: choose my wallet or a third-party payment gateway and pay the approved extra-hours amount now
requirements.rules: Wallet payment requires a sufficient balance; split payments are not required. The gateway is a sandbox, and the platform must not store card numbers, CVVs or gateway passwords. Apply the approved hours and courses only after successful payment.
requirements.implementation: Sufficient-wallet guard, no split, explicit sandbox outcome form and successful-response-only confirmation.
requirements.coverage: partial: adapter present; documented server gap remains

requirements.action: confirm that the approved extra-hours amount will be added to my next university installment

requirements.implementation: Deferral sends option=deferred only; confirmation says outstanding amount due, not money collected.

requirements.action: refund a paid extra-hours charge or cancel an unpaid deferred charge for an eligible cancelled request
requirements.rules: A paid amount is refunded to the student's wallet and cannot be refunded twice. An unpaid deferred charge is removed from the next installment without crediting the wallet. In both cases, revoke the related extra hours and unapplied schedule additions and retain the reversal history.
requirements.implementation: Eligibility/reversal review distinguishes paid refund from unpaid deferred cancellation. Execution is intentionally unavailable; no unsafe financial POST is sent.

knownGaps.description: The supplied API permits creation by an advisor not assigned to the student. The new UI restricts selection but does not replace a server authorization check.
Create/eligibility calculations do not account correctly for earlier activated requests. UI per-request limits and a visible warning are not a cumulative server guarantee.
The supplied API accepts blank notes and can approve stale eligibility. The adapter adds client-side guards only; a direct/concurrent API caller can bypass them.
Wallet deductions for different requests are not atomic across concurrent settlements. An in-flight UI lock prevents repeated local clicks, not cross-tab/request overspending.
The audited reversal path leaves the original request marked paid and omits the reversal from request history.

Ineligible reversals, incorrect credits for unpaid deferrals, missing credit/addition revocation, duplicate concurrent credits and wallet double-counting remain. Live reversal is disabled in the adapter.

The shared C1 policy can allow 25 credits at GPA 3.70 with stale non-probation standing/reason, despite the required 23-credit allowance. Planner save/submit/accept still depend on that server policy.
The pending-work API omits graduation-plan, exit-exam and financial-reversal categories. This submission does not fabricate records or invent a combined feed.
